clips.caption:
A man moved to Thailand, married, and opened a local bank account - and paid every dollar of US tax he owed.

The law changed. A new form appeared for that account. He found out, filled it out, and mailed it in five days late.

That's it. No missing taxes, no hidden money - a form, five days after the deadline.

A felony. One year in prison. Not for debt. For paperwork.

Kevin Trudeau watched him break down over a technicality, next to people who'd done real damage. His own rule: accept what you can't change, and embrace it anyway.

Have you been punished harder for a small mistake than someone who caused real harm?

#kevintrudeau #prisonstory #adversity #mindsettraining #wealthmindset #resilience

When Kevin Trudeau went to prison, he watched grown men sob every night over ruined lives - bankers, judges, drug dealers, all broken by the same four walls.

He made a different choice. He couldn't change being there, so he decided: I'd rather be happy than miserable. It's a choice.

He didn't pretend prison was good. He just refused to hand it his misery for free - and chose, on purpose, to embrace it as an opportunity instead.

What's the hardest thing in your life right now you could choose to get something out of, instead of just surviving it?

#kevintrudeau #prisonmindset #choosehappiness #mentaltoughness #selfimprovement #gratitude
